title: Make global text render green by fixing Tailwind OKLCH token variables

requirements.summary: Update theme CSS variables to use raw OKLCH components so Tailwind’s `text-foreground` resolves to green in light and dark modes.
acceptanceCriteria: After rebuild, body text (inherited default text) renders green across the app screens (Hero, Header, tabs, forms, panels) without requiring per-component overrides.

`frontend/src/index.css` uses variable values compatible with `tailwind.config.js` (no nested `oklch(oklch(...))` patterns for theme tokens like `--foreground`, `--background`, `--card`, `--muted`, etc.).
In both light and dark modes, `text-foreground` results in green text that is visibly different from white/gray/black.
No changes are made to any frontend immutable paths (e.g., `frontend/src/main.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x)`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/components/ui/*`).

file_operations.description: Replace `--*` theme token values currently written as `oklch(...)` with raw OKLCH components (e.g., `--foreground: 0.88 0.28 145;`) so Tailwind’s `oklch(var(--...))` wrapping in `frontend/tailwind.config.js` does not create nested `oklch(oklch(...))`. Ensure both `:root` and `.dark` define `--foreground` (and related `*-foreground` tokens like `--card-foreground`, `--popover-foreground`, `--secondary-foreground`, etc.) as clearly green so default/inherited text becomes visibly green across the UI.

requirements.summary: Remove/replace non-token text color usage in non-immutable components so text follows theme tokens and renders green by default.
acceptanceCriteria: Spot-check: Header brand text, tab labels, panel titles, form labels/inputs, tables, and recommendation text all appear green (or green-tinted via theme tokens) rather than default black/white.
Any explicit text color utility classes that prevent the global green text from showing are removed/replaced in non-immutable components.

file_operations.description: Audit and update any hardcoded or token-incompatible color strings used for chart axes/tooltip styling (e.g., `hsl(var(--muted-foreground))`, `hsl(var(--popover))`, `hsl(var(--border))`, `hsl(var(--chart-1))`) so they correctly reference the app’s Tailwind OKLCH token variables (using `oklch(var(--...))`-compatible values) and therefore render green-tinted text/labels consistently with the theme.
